mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 59 degrees and overcast near the Military Ridge State Trail with an air quality index of 53. We are currently under a third quarter moon, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

For city news, residents are reminded that curbside refuse and recycling are under contract with Pellitteri Waste Systems. You can find collection maps, calendars, and a helpful Waste Wizard tool on the city website to help you sort your trash and recyclables properly.

There is plenty to do around town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow is packed with trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's to keep the energy going.

In our weekly police recap, officers responded to a call on October 25 where a man was arrested for O W I after being located in his vehicle for an extended period at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop later this morning.
